# Governing Policy Research: ACL Reconstruction (CPT 29888) Denial — Ambetter of North Carolina

## Summary of findings

Ambetter of North Carolina Inc. delegates utilization management of non-emergent knee (and hip/shoulder/spine) surgery to **Evolent Specialty Services, Inc.** (formerly National Imaging Associates, Inc. / "NIA"), accessed through the RadMD portal. This is confirmed on Ambetter of North Carolina's own provider-news page ("Ambetter of North Carolina Inc. partners with New Century Health (NCH) and National Imaging Associates (NIA) for the utilization management of certain services... As of Jan. 1, 2024, New Century Health and NIA are now Evolent Specialty Services, Inc."). CPT 29888 (arthroscopic ACL reconstruction) falls under Evolent's **Knee Arthroscopy** clinical guideline, which explicitly lists CPT 29888 under "Knee Ligament Reconstruction/Repair."

I was able to retrieve the full guideline text (guideline number Evolent_CG‑316, and its current renumbered successor Evolent_CG‑1764) and a public "Clinical Tip Sheet" that quotes the operative ACL criteria verbatim. Critically, the ACL section of this guideline states that ACL reconstruction does **not** require a documented trial of conservative treatment when certain objective findings are present — which directly bears on this denial's stated rationale.

# Governing Policy Research: ACL Reconstruction (CPT 29888) Denial — Ambetter of North Carolina

## Summary of findings

Ambetter of North Carolina Inc. delegates utilization management of non-emergent knee (and hip/shoulder/spine) surgery to **Evolent Specialty Services, Inc.** (formerly National Imaging Associates, Inc. / "NIA"), accessed through the RadMD portal. This is confirmed on Ambetter of North Carolina's own provider-news page ("Ambetter of North Carolina Inc. partners with New Century Health (NCH) and National Imaging Associates (NIA) for the utilization management of certain services... As of Jan. 1, 2024, New Century Health and NIA are now Evolent Specialty Services, Inc."). CPT 29888 (arthroscopic ACL reconstruction) falls under Evolent's **Knee Arthroscopy** clinical guideline, which explicitly lists CPT 29888 under "Knee Ligament Reconstruction/Repair."

I was able to retrieve the full guideline text (guideline number Evolent_CG‑316, and its current renumbered successor Evolent_CG‑1764) and a public "Clinical Tip Sheet" that quotes the operative ACL criteria verbatim. Critically, the ACL section of this guideline states that ACL reconstruction does **not** require a documented trial of conservative treatment when certain objective findings are present — which directly bears on this denial's stated rationale.
